20.name: Bumper Cars
20.content:
Bring the thrill and excitement of BUMPER CARS to your venue!! Bumper Cars is a Family/Carnival ride that consists of several small electric cars which use power from the floor and/or ceiling. These cars can be turned on and off remotely by the operator.

Not interested in an electric set-up? There are also versions that use rechargeable batteries, and these avoid the conductive floor/ceiling set up of traditional bumper cars. They charge for around 6-8 hours, and once charged last for a long time before needing to be recharged. Players simply put their foot on the pedal to move and take their foot off to stop. Since these types of bumper cars aren’t connected to a grid, they can be used in large areas such as shopping malls, carnivals, etc and can easily be moved.
